work: 東方非想天則 ～ 超弩級ギニョルの謎を追え (Touhou Hisoutensoku, 2009)
author: 黄昏フロンティア / 上海アリス幻樂団
notes: The 120-sprite reference that calibration.py was built from. **Recorded late, and that lateness is the problem**: the reference table was published with PROVENANCE naming the game but nothing forced a reader to treat the sample as one art direction. Pairing its outline_variation median (0.726) with TH155 sprites (0.003) reported a whole generation of correct work as defective. 3853 eligible 8bpp frames; 120 sampled with a fixed seed.

work: 東方憑依華 ～ Antinomy of Common Flowers (Touhou 15.5, 2017)
author: 黄昏フロンティア / 上海アリス幻樂団
notes: 8bpp indexed sprites inside th155.pak, decoded with the container's own TFPA palette. Lossless by construction: the pixels are palette indices, so nothing has been re-encoded. 17 character containers, each with a named frame table; the sprite run and palette run are adjacent and pair as [palette][sprites][container]. Per-character outline_variation medians: doremy 0.000, futo 0.055, hijiri 0.000, reimu 0.041 -- i.e. the metric tracks palette structure, not a drawing convention.

url: (previous session, provenance recorded in calibration.py PROVENANCE)
author: multiple
notes: **Kept as a counter-example, not as art evidence.** These are rendered frames: opaque and full-canvas, so bbox_fill read 1.000 and outline_variation 0.000 and 40/40 were flagged. After background removal and tight cropping the same frames read 0.642 / 0.564, inside the reference range. Second caveat: the frames were JPEG-reconstructed, so palette_size was pinned by our own quantisation to 16 -- that column is not art evidence and must not be used.
